findings.detail: The constructor checks both the saved J1 gzip receipt bytes and the equality of its decoded result with the supplied receipt. It uses the 2878 saved oriented exposure-excluded packet addresses per provider and does not perform a fresh packet enumeration.

Both left and right placements preserve the selected four-gate order and the relative order and frames of all unselected gates. The adjacent crossing log is an exact scalar algebra certificate; it does not assert feasibility of intermediate framed words. Ordinary add commutations use the exact dependency condition, and scale/self-add cases use exact forward and inverse-transpose operators. Singular or unsupported scalar operations have typed exclusions.

The full window records the preceding and following contacts of every touched raw register, preserving virtual aliases and all exterior equalities. Consecutive duplicate nodes from self-add contacts are collapsed only for neighbor lookup, not for cost accounting.

Billing uses canonical operand-register semantics, including scale and self-add contacts, actual subspace containment, and each first outside successor exactly once per register. Fixed centre-descents cancel. The unchanged-context bill plus the factored four-gate block bill equals the complete new window bill; selected-only billing is not used as the reported delta.

The inherited five middle-frame vertices and two choices at each end produce twenty labeled corners at the actual gathered-block boundaries. Exact forced-equality faces are filtered. The proof is conditional on fixed remaining gates, fixed exterior frames, deterministic placement, and the registered concave rank-jump cost.

Retention reconstructs the gather and compares its crossing list, interval and hashes with the saved plan. It checks full-window forward and dual operators, direct versus decomposed full billing, unchanged exterior contacts and semantic barriers, and canonical full paid-profile and derived-cleanup parity. Four-to-four replacement preserves warp index counts but does not itself certify native primitive costs.

Recursive string-key canonicalization makes integer-key certificates stable under JSON persistence and rejects converted-key collisions. Controls explicitly cover round-trip identity and collision rejection. Full boundary certificates and the complete plan hash are bound to pricing and retained witnesses.

Unexecuted controls cover all 24 selected-edge interleavings across both placements, kinds, carriers and inner orders; exact signed positive fixtures; independent small-field frame flags; direct versus decomposed full bills; noncommuting crossings; frame-infeasible gathers; omitted interveners and successors; forced equalities; equal-rank wrong orientations; scalar singularities; stale or missing source/plan data; and prelude, warp, section and alias barriers.

The runner binds individual and aggregate tariff, guard, row, interval, crossing and window-boundary certificates using the constructor digest. It verifies the placement partition, exact plan-ordinal and label coverage, used compact references and two-seed agreement. Empty eligible domains and unresolved cases remain EXPLORATORY rather than scientific NULL.

limitations: This is a static implementation review. No assertion is made that any registered control or candidate passed at runtime.

Corner completeness applies only to the registered fixed-context, deterministic-placement family; it is not a claim about unrestricted retiming, global frame optimization, general confluence, or an intrinsic sandpile Laplacian.
A favorable local moment would still require fresh native, prefix, physical-owner, supplier and outer-admission obligations before any conditional kappa improvement could be claimed.
The review preserves source attribution and existing scientific stops; it does not convert the unrun CONTINUATION-10 family into a completed experiment.
review_method: Read-only source inspection and mathematical reasoning; source-byte hashes rechecked when this receipt was written. No scientific module was imported, no candidate or control was executed, and no source-word census was run.
